paper_title: Feedback Friction LLMs Struggle to Fully Incorporate External Feedback
caption: Accuracy of Llama3.3 on PopQA with respect to s_pop and o_pop
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the accuracy of Llama3.3 on PopQA with respect to s_pop frequency. The x-axis is labeled "s_pop frequency (x10^4)" with a linear scale, ranging from 1 to 19, and tick labels at intervals of 2. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy" with a linear scale, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, and tick labels at intervals of 0.2. The plot contains two lines: a blue dashed line with circle markers and a green solid line with square markers. The blue line starts at approximately 0.86 accuracy at an s_pop frequency of 1 x 10^4 and remains relatively steady, with a slight dip to around 0.84 at 13 x 10^4, before returning to 1.0 at 17 x 10^4. The green line begins at around 0.38 accuracy at 1 x 10^4, increases to a peak of approximately 0.68 at 7 x 10^4, then fluctuates, decreasing to around 0.45 at 9 x 10^4 and 0.48 at 15 x 10^4, before rising sharply to 1.0 at 17 x 10^4. Both lines have error bars indicating the range of accuracy values.
